updateCommand.description: Argument arrays used to update an installed tool. A platform entry overrides the default; an empty array disables updates on that platform.

lang.description: Implementation language used for sorting and grouping.

name.description: Display name and tool-level lookup key.

cmds.description: Executable names checked on PATH. The sorter uses the tool name when this is omitted.

install_command.description: Command used to install the tool.

completions_command.description: Command used to generate shell completions.

init_command.description: Command used to generate shell initialization code.

supported_shells.description: Shell names accepted by the completion or initialization command. The sorter uses its standard shell set when this is omitted.

append_fish_completion.description: Text appended to the Fish completion command.

append_fish_init.description: Text appended to the Fish initialization command.

command_bash_name.description: Bash argument override for the generation command.

command_fish_name.description: Fish argument override for the generation command.

command_nu_name.description: Nushell argument override for the generation command.

command_powershell_name.description: PowerShell argument override for the generation command.

command_zsh_name.description: Zsh argument override for the generation command.

completions_command_only_if_no.description: Installed commands that suppress completion generation.

completions_cmds.description: Executable subset used when the completion command contains CMD.

init_command_only_if_no.description: Installed commands that suppress initialization generation.
